MP / R1 170001224
Charger ID/Serial No.
:
tUN7ix
Problem Description
: Charger Offline
Troubleshooting
:
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is currently offline. Unfortunately, we are unable to take further action remotely without an active SCB connection. As the next step, I recommend performing a hard reset via the OCPP server if the charger is connected through OCPP. If a remote reset via OCPP is not possible, a local reboot will be required to bring the charger back online. If the charger remains offline after these actions, a site visit will be necessary to inspect the router settings and assess the network signal strength. Please let us know if you require any further assistance.
For future reference, your case number is
0420078
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
